;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]], [[Afghan peace process]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces]] says it has carried out its first [[airstrike]] against the [[Taliban]] since a peace deal was signed in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/conducts-air-strike-taliban-peace-deal-200304085937305.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] engages "hostile objects" over the central [[Homs Governorate]] and southern [[Quneitra Governorate]]. [[Syrian Arab News Agency|Syrian state media]] says [[Israel]] is behind the attacks. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/276850 (''Israel National News'')] [https://www.rt.com/news/482349-syria-intercepts-hostile-targets/ (RT)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020|United States tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020]]
**The [[National Weather Service]] reports 11 [[tornado]]es touched down resulting in 25 confirmed deaths. Eighteen people remain unaccounted for. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/04/weather/tennessee-tornado-wednesday/index.html (CNN)]
**140 buildings were destroyed with thousands damaged. 44,000 people are without electric power. [https://www.waff.com/2020/03/03/two-tornadoes-touch-down-tennessee-one-near-downtown-nashville/ (WAFF)]
*[[Mount Merapi]] in [[Java]], [[Indonesia]] erupts, forcing the airport in [[Surakarta]] to close. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-51727044/mount-merapi-volcano-eruption-spews-enormous-ash-cloud (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Wallis and Futuna]] turns away a German [[cruise ship]] due to fears of coronavirus, and says that it is studying the possibility of denying another ship entry. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/410932/coronavirus-cruise-ship-banned-from-wallis-and-futuna (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] says all schools and universities will close from March 5 through March 15 to stop the spread of the virus, as the country confirms a total of 3,090 cases and 107 COVID-19-related deaths. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/04/italys-death-toll-from-the-coronavirus-is-now-worse-than-iran.html (CNBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/04/italy-orders-closure-of-schools-and-universities-due-to-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports its second death in [[Basque Country (autonomous community)|Basque Country]], an 82-year-old man, as infected toll rises to more than 210. [https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/salud/2020/03/04/5e5f5685fc6c83827b8b45cf.html (''El Mundo'')]
***[[Hungary]] confirms first two COVID-19 cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-hungary/hungary-confirms-first-two-coronavirus-cases-idUSKBN20R2RA (Reuters)]
***[[Slovenia]] confirms its first case of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. The patient had recently travelled home from [[Morocco]], passing through [[Italy]] on the way, and is now in isolation at the [[Ljubljana University Medical Centre]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-slovenia/slovenia-confirms-first-case-of-coronavirus-health-minister-idUKKBN20R341?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The first in-person use of the [[CRISPR]]-[[Cas9]] [[genome editing]] tool is conducted, intended to reverse a genetic mutation causing [[Leber congenital amaurosis]], a form of [[Heredity|inherited]] [[blindness]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2020/mar/04/doctors-use-gene-editing-tool-crispr-inside-body-for-first-time (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Canada–Iran relations]], [[Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752]]
**Canadian Foreign Minister [[François-Philippe Champagne]] urges [[Iran]] to allow access to the [[flight recorder]]s of the Ukrainian passenger plane that was shot down in January. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-canada/on-ukraine-visit-canada-minister-presses-iran-for-access-to-black-boxes-from-plane-crash-idUSKBN20R2T8 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Egypt]] [[capital punishment in Egypt|executes]] top [[Ansar al-Sharia (Egypt)|Ansar al-Sharia]] militant [[Hesham Ashmawy|Hisham al-Ashmawy]], a former special forces officer who was convicted over several high-profile attacks, the country's [[Egyptian Armed Forces|military]] spokesman said. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/egypt-executes-top-militant-extradited-from-libya-idUSKBN20R1C7 (Reuters)]
*The U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] (FDA) bans the use of electroshock devices for [[Operant conditioning|aversive conditioning]] on patients with [[mental disorder]]s. The [[Judge Rotenberg Educational Center]] in [[Massachusetts]], the last U.S. institution that still uses electroshock devices to punish patients, say they will challenge the federal ban in court. [https://apnews.com/9c51ec8935818d84dbfa7e43f890c9ec (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**After a poor performance on [[Results_of_the_2020_Democratic_Party_presidential_primaries#Super_Tuesday|Super Tuesday]], former [[Mayor of New York City|New York City Mayor]] [[Michael Bloomberg]] suspends his [[Michael Bloomberg 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] and endorses former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/mike-bloomberg-suspends-presidential-campaign-after-super-tuesday-show (Fox News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election/bloomberg-abandons-presidential-bid-as-biden-surge-reshapes-democratic-race-idUSKBN20R0XX (Reuters)]
*[[Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**Avoiding questions about lower-than-expected [[GDP]] growth in his first year as [[President of Brazil]], [[Jair Bolsonaro]] invites an impersonator to the restricted press section around the [[Palácio do Planalto|Planalto Palace]] to answer the questions in his stead. The comedian also distributed bananas (in reference to the name given in Brazil to the ''[[bras d'honneur]]'') to the attending journalists. [https://economia.estadao.com.br/noticias/geral,bolsonaro-usa-humorista-para-nao-responder-sobre-pib-fraco,70003219486 (''Estado de S. Paulo'')]
*[[Government of Ukraine]]
**[[Oleksiy Honcharuk]] and [[Honcharuk Government|his government]] are voted out by the [[Verkhovna Rada]] after less than six months in office. [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] proposes [[Denys Shmygal]] as [[Prime Minister of Ukraine|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/04/ukrainian-president-removes-pm-government-reshuffle-volodymyr-zelenskiy (''The Guardian'')]
